name: Sichuan Hongda Co.,Ltd
summary: Sichuan Hongda Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sales of chemical products in China. The company offers fertilizers and industrial-grade monoammonium phosphate; rare metals, such as molybdenum, indium, and germanium; and compound fertilizers, phosphoric acid, monoammonium phosphate, industrial sulfuric acid, zinc ingots, zinc alloys, and zinc oxide. It also provides commercial liquid ammonia; and water-soluble fertilizer, biological organic fertilizer, diamond phosphate, and building plaster products.
